metadata.title: APPSC EO Grade-III — Andhra Pradesh 28 Districts Revision Atlas
metadata.note: Andhra Pradesh comprises 26 official administrative districts as per Act 12 of 1920 / April 2022 Gazette notifications. The working list of 28 includes proposed/unnotified divisions Markapuram (under Prakasam) and Polavaram (under Eluru/ASR), which are fully documented under their respective official parent districts.

districts.name: Alluri Sitharama Raju (ASR)
waterResources: Polavaram Irrigation Project (headworks area near Anguluru/Ramachandrapuram)
terrain: Armakonda / Jindhagada peak (1,680m - highest peak in AP)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Papikonda National Park (covers parts of ASR and Eluru)
Tropical moist deciduous and dry deciduous forests
historicalNotes: Rampa Rebellion (1922–24): Alluri Sitharama Raju led tribal revolt against British Forest Act 1882 (Muttam system)

temples.name: Modamamba Temple
uniqueFacts: Revered as the principal protective mother deity of the Agency region

temples.name: Ananthagiri Cave Temple
uniqueFacts: Associated with natural formations near Borra Caves

quickExtras: Borra Caves: Karst limestone caves formed by the Gosthani River
dontConfuse: Araku is the main tourism hub, but Paderu is the official district headquarters.

districts.name: Anakapalli
terrain: Coastal plains interspersed with isolated hillocks
disasters: High cyclone vulnerability (Bay of Bengal coast)
crops: Sugarcane (Anakapalli Jaggery Market - one of the largest in India)
historicalNotes: Buddhist Era (3rd c. BCE - 7th c. CE): Major Theravada/Mahayana Buddhist monastic complexes at Bojjannakonda and Lingalakonda (Sankaram village)

temples.name: Nookambika Temple
uniqueFacts: Major regional Shakti shrine; annual Jatara starts on Kotappakonda/Mahashivaratri bahula amavasya

temples.name: Upamaka Venkateswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Ancient Vaishnava Kshetram featuring Swayambhu idol on Garudadri hill

temples.name: Bojjannakonda & Lingalakonda
uniqueFacts: 3rd c. BCE - 7th c. CE rock-cut Buddhist stupas, chaityas, and Viharas

quickExtras: Pudimadaka Port: Proposed non-major port/fishing harbor
dontConfuse: Bojjannakonda is an ASI Monolithic Archaeological Site, NOT an Endowments-managed functioning temple.

districts.name: Ananthapuramu
disasters: Severe chronic drought (lowest average rainfall district in AP after Leh in India context historically)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Great Indian Bustard habitat fringe zone (near Kurnool border)

temples.name: Bugga Ramalingeswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Famous for intricate Vijayanagara stone carvings and granite cutwork; features a continuous underground spring under the main Shiva Lingam

temples.name: Chintala Venkataramana Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Complete Ramayana and Bhagavata narratives sculpted across the prakara walls; stone chariot in courtyard

temples.name: Kasapuram Nettikanti Anjaneya Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Major Endowments-administered Hanuman shrine drawing millions of pilgrims

quickExtras: Gooty Fort: Citadel built on a massive monolith rock; held by Chalukyas, Vijayanagara, Marathas (Murari Rao), Hyder Ali, and the British
dontConfuse: Lepakshi (Veerabhadra Temple) is now located in Sri Sathya Sai District, NOT in Ananthapuramu District post-2022 reorganisation.

districts.name: Annamayya
disasters: Flash floods in river valleys (e.g., 2021 Cheyyeru dam burst flooding)
crops: Tomato (Madanapalle market - largest tomato trading center in Asia)

temples.name: Tallapaka Temples (Siddheswara & Chennakesava)
uniqueFacts: Birthplace of Saint Composer Tallapaka Annamacharya (Annamayya)

temples.name: Parasurama Temple
uniqueFacts: Believed site where Parasurama was cleansed of his sin of matricide; major holy bath site

temples.name: Veerabhadra Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Features a distinct Vijayanagara Rajagopuram; central temple of the district HQ

quickExtras: Horsley Hills (Yenugulla Mallamma Konda): Summer hill station at ~1,265m elevation near Madanapalle
dontConfuse: Annamayya District HQ is Rayachoti, not Rajampet or Madanapalle.

districts.name: Bapatla
economy: Agricultural College Bapatla (ANGRAU premier historic institution)

temples.name: Bhavanarayana Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Major ancient Swayambhu Vishnu shrine featuring documented Chola and Eastern Chalukya epigraphs and structural additions

temples.name: Ramalingeswara Temple
uniqueFacts: Historic coastal Shaivite shrine near fishing centers

festivalsAndCulture: Kotappakonda-style Prabhalu traditions in rural mandals
quickExtras: Nizampatnam Port: Historic maritime trade port (site of first British factory setup point on the Coromandel Coast - 1611)
dontConfuse: Bhavanarayana Swamy Temple is at Bapatla town, distinct from Mangalagiri Panakala Narasimha Swamy in Guntur.

districts.name: Chittoor
disasters: Human-elephant conflict along the Palamaner-Kaundinya forest corridor
crops: Mango (Totapuri/Alphonso - leading fruit processing hub in AP)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Kaundinya Wildlife Sanctuary (only Asian Elephant sanctuary in Andhra Pradesh)

temples.name: Kanipakam Varasiddhi Vinayaka Temple
uniqueFacts: Famous Swayambhu Ganesha shrine situated in the Neeva riverbed; tradition records growing stone idol; Grade-I temple
festivals: Kanipakam Annual Brahmotsavams (21-day festival starting on Vinayaka Chavithi)

temples.name: Mogileswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Ancient Shiva temple with a continuous natural spring flowing out of Nandi's mouth

temples.name: Aragonda Anjaneya Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Associated with Sanjeevani hill drops legend during Ramayana epic era

quickExtras: Gurramkonda Fort: Historic hill fortress held by Vijayanagara, Nawabs of Cuddapah, Hyder Ali, and Tipu Sultan
dontConfuse: Tirumala/Tirupati and Srikalahasti are now in Tirupati District, NOT in Chittoor District.

districts.name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema
waterResources: Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage canals network (Central Delta Canal, Bank Canal)
disasters: Riverine floods during Godavari peak discharge
economy: ONGC / GAIL Natural Gas and Petroleum onshore wells (KG Basin)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary (southern section adjacent to delta mouth - mangroves, Fishing Cat, Otters)

temples.name: Ainavilli Siddhi Vinayaka Temple
uniqueFacts: Renowned Swayambhu Ganesha shrine located in the central delta

temples.name: Antarvedi Laxmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Situated at Sagara Sangam (confluence of Vasishta Godavari and Bay of Bengal); features historic temple chariot (Ratham)

temples.name: Ryali Jaganmohini Kesava Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Single Salagrama stone carved into Lord Kesava (Vishnu) on front side and Jaganmohini (female avatar) on rear side

temples.name: Muramalla Veereswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Famous for daily Nitya Kalyanam rituals performed for divine couple

temples.name: Appanapalli Bala Balaji Temple
uniqueFacts: Popular regional pilgrimage shrine known as Second Chinna Tirupati

festivalsAndCulture: Prabhala Tirtham (Jaganna Thota during Sankranti - unique coconut-trunk decorated arches carried across paddy fields)
quickExtras: Prabhala Tirtham: Centuries-old eco-cultural tradition where villages assemble giant bamboo-and-coconut arches (Prabhas)
dontConfuse: Ryali Kesava Swamy is NOT two separate images placed back to back; it is a single carved Salagrama stone displaying Male/Female avatars on opposite sides.

sources.title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema District Portal

districts.name: East Godavari
waterResources: Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage (Dowleswaram) - splits Godavari into Gautami and Vasishta branches
disasters: High river flood risk from Godavari discharge (monsoon discharges above 20 lakh cusecs cause major inundation)
crops: Nursery plants (Kadiyam - largest plant nursery hub in India)
dynasties: Reddy Dynasty (Anavota Reddy / Kataya Vema Reddy)
historicalNotes: Rajaraja Narendra established Rajamahendravaram as capital in 11th Century; patronized Adikavi Nannaya for Telugu Mahabharatam translation

temples.name: Kotilingeswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Ancient Shaivite temple located on the banks of Godavari with 55 bathing ghats

temples.name: Pattiseema Veerabhadra Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Situated on Devakuta hillock in the middle of the Godavari River

temples.name: Markandeya Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Ancient temple associated with Sage Markandeya on Godavari bank

quickExtras: Dowleswaram Barrage: Historic hydraulic structure designed by Sir Arthur Cotton (1847–1852), transforming the Godavari delta
dontConfuse: Headquarters of East Godavari post-2022 reorganisation is Rajamahendravaram (Kakinada is now a separate district).

districts.name: Eluru
waterResources: Polavaram Right Canal passing through district
terrain: Flat alluvial plain merging into agency forest slopes in the north
disasters: Severe drainage congestion around Kolleru Lake during rains
Tammileru flash floods in Eluru city
crops: Oil Palm (Eluru/Pedavegi leading hub in India)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Kolleru Wildlife Sanctuary (Ramsar Site & Important Bird Area - major breeding ground for Spot-billed Pelicans and Grey Herons)
historicalNotes: Pedavegi (Vengipura) near Eluru served as capital of Salankayanas and Vishnukundins (4th–7th Century CE)

temples.name: Dwaraka Tirumala (Chinna Tirupati)
uniqueFacts: Swayambhu hill temple dedicated to Lord Venkateswara; major Grade-I shrine in AP
festivals: Dwaraka Tirumala Annual Brahmotsavams (Vaisakha and Asvin months)

temples.name: Pedavegi Archaeological Site
uniqueFacts: Capital of ancient Vengi kingdom; features ruins of ancient stupas and structural temples

temples.name: Guntupalli Buddhist Caves
uniqueFacts: Rock-cut Buddhist caves, circular chaitya griha, and stupas dating from 3rd c. BCE to 2nd c. CE

quickExtras: Polavaram Project Hub: Key canal headworks and administrative resettlements located in this belt
dontConfuse: Kolleru Lake spans Eluru and West Godavari districts, but the main sanctuary administrative headquarters is centered at Eluru.

districts.name: Guntur
waterResources: Prakasam Barrage canals (Krishna Western Main Canal)
crops: Chili (Guntur Mirchi Market - largest chili yard in Asia, GI Tag for Guntur Sannam Chili)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Scrub forests on Kondaveedu / Mangalagiri hillocks

temples.name: Mangalagiri Panakala Narasimha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Swayambhu shrine on hillock where deity accepts jaggery water (Panakam) poured into mouth; foot temple features tall 11-storey Gopuram built by Raja Vasireddy Venkatadri Nayudu

temples.name: Amaralingeswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: One of the 5 Pancharama Kshetrams (Amareshwara); located on Krishna riverbank; features a 15-foot high white marble Shiva Lingam

temples.name: Agastyeswara Temple
uniqueFacts: Major Shaivite and Rahu-Ketu dosha nivarana shrine in central AP

quickExtras: Kondaveedu Fort: Hill fortress with 21 structures, ramparts, and ancient reservoirs built by Reddi dynasty
dontConfuse: Amaravati Heritage Stupa site is in Palnadu/Guntur border belt, but the Amaralingeswara Pancharama Temple is directly managed under AP Endowments.

districts.name: Kakinada
waterResources: Yeleru Reservoir Project (Yeleswaram) - supplies water to Kakinada port city and Visakhapatnam Steel Plant
terrain: Hope Island spit forming natural harbor bay
disasters: High vulnerability to severe cyclonic storms
economy: Kakinada Deep Water Port & Anchorage Port
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary (2nd largest mangrove ecosystem in India; home to endangered White-backed Vulture, Fishing Cat, Saltwater Crocodile)
dynasties: Pithapuram Samsthanam (Rao Venkata Kumara Mahipathi Surya Rao Bahadur)

temples.name: Pithapuram Kukkuteswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: One of the 18 Maha Shakti Peethas (Puruhootika Devi) and a Pada Gaya Kshetram; features Swayambhu Dattatreya (Sripada Srivallabha birth context)

temples.name: Draksharama Bheemeshwara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: One of the Pancharama Kshetrams and a Maha Shakti Peetha (Manikyamba); built by Eastern Chalukya King Bhima I (892–922 CE); features a 14-foot crystalline Shiva Lingam extending through two storeys

temples.name: Annavaram Veera Venkata Satyanarayana Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Second richest Endowments temple in AP after Tirupati; unique two-story temple layout representing Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva; world-famous for Satyanarayana Vratam

quickExtras: Hope Island: A 16-km long narrow sand spit formed by Godavari sediment outflow, protecting Kakinada coast from open sea waves
dontConfuse: Both Draksharama and Samalkota (Kumara Bheemeshwara) are Pancharama temples located within Kakinada District.

districts.name: Krishna
waterResources: Krishna East Delta canal network (Bandar Canal, Ryves Canal, Eluru Canal)
disasters: Tidal surges (e.g., 1977 Diviseema Cyclone impact zone)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Krishna Wildlife Sanctuary (mangrove habitat at Krishna delta mouth - otters, fishing cats, migratory birds)

temples.name: Srikrikakuleswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Temple where Andhra Vishnu is worshipped; patronized by Vijayanagara Emperor Krishnadevaraya who was inspired here to compose Amuktamalyada

temples.name: Mova Venugopala Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Associated with Siddhendra Yogi (founder of Kuchipudi) and Kshetrayya (famous Padams composer)

temples.name: Ghantasala Buddhist Stupa
uniqueFacts: Historic 2nd-century Buddhist monastic mound and trade settlement

festivalsAndCulture: Kuchipudi Classical Dance heritage traditions (Kuchipudi village is located in this district)
quickExtras: Diviseema: Island formed by the bifurcating arms of Krishna River before joining Bay of Bengal
dontConfuse: Andhra Vishnu Srikakuleswara Temple is in Krishna District (Srikakulam village), NOT in North-Coastal Srikakulam District.

districts.name: Kurnool
disasters: Urban flash flooding along Handri/Tungabhadra confluence (e.g., 2009 Kurnool floods)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary (famous for Great Indian Bustard, Lesser Florican, Blackbuck)
historicalNotes: Kurnool City served as the Capital of Andhra State from 1953 to 1956.

temples.name: Yaganti Uma Maheshwara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Famous for growing monolithic stone Nandi idol (studied by GSI/ASI), Pushkarini fed by continuous hill spring, and Agastya Cave

temples.name: Orvakal Rock Garden Temple Caves
uniqueFacts: Natural quartz and silica rock formations featuring ancient cave shelters

quickExtras: Kondareddy Buroju: Historic circular bastion in Kurnool city used as a watchtower and prison during freedom struggle
dontConfuse: Srisailam Temple is in Nandyal District, NOT Kurnool District post-2022 reorganisation.

sources.title: AP Endowments & Forest Dept Rollapadu Records

districts.name: Nandyal
waterResources: Srisailam Dam (Hydroelectric power project on Krishna)
disasters: Localized flash flooding in Kunderu basin
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Nagarjunasagar Srisailam Tiger Reserve (NSTR - largest Tiger Reserve in India by core area)
dynasties: Vijayanagara Emperors (Harihara I, Krishnadevaraya constructed gopurams and stone pathways)

temples.name: Srisailam Mallikarjuna & Bhramaramba Temple
uniqueFacts: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas (Mallikarjuna) and one of the 18 Maha Shakti Peethas (Bhramaramba); situated on Nallamala hills along Krishna river (Patalaganga)

temples.name: Ahobilam Nava Narasimha Temples
uniqueFacts: Major Sri Vaishnava Divya Desam divided into Upper Ahobilam and Lower Ahobilam; features 9 distinct forms of Narasimha spread across hills

temples.name: Mahanandi Mahanandiswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Ancient Shaivite temple surrounded by Nallamala hills; famous for crystal-clear pushkarini water originating directly under the main Shiva Lingam

temples.name: Navanandi Temples
uniqueFacts: Historic circuit of 9 Nandi temples surrounding Nandyal town

quickExtras: Srisailam Shikhareswaram: Highest peak in the area offering view of the Srisailam temple complex and Krishna river
dontConfuse: Both premier national pilgrimage hubs—Srisailam and Ahobilam—are located in Nandyal District (carved out of Kurnool in 2022).

districts.name: NTR
disasters: High urban flash flood vulnerability (Budameru overflow / Krishna river discharge up to 10+ lakh cusecs)
economy: Dr. Narla Tata Rao Thermal Power Station (NTTPS)
crafts: Kondapalli Toys (Kondapalli Bommalu - GI Tagged, crafted from Tella Poniki soft wood)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Kondapalli Reserve Forest (habitat for rare flora, leopard, wild boar, softwood Tella Poniki trees)

temples.name: Kanakadurga Temple
uniqueFacts: Swayambhu deity situated on Indrakeeladri hill on the banks of Krishna River; premier Shakti pilgrimage center in AP
festivals: Dasara Navaratri at Indrakeeladri (Teppotsavam in Krishna river)

temples.name: Mogalarajapuram Cave Temples
uniqueFacts: 5th–6th Century CE Vishnukundin-era rock-cut cave temples

temples.name: Undavalli Caves
uniqueFacts: 4-storey rock-cut cave complex featuring huge monolithic Anantasayana Vishnu sculpture

temples.name: Vedadri Narasimha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Pancha Narasimha Kshetram situated on the Krishna riverbank

quickExtras: Kondapalli Fort: 14th-century hill fortress constructed by Prolaya Vema Reddi
dontConfuse: Vijayawada is the HQ of NTR District, while Machilipatnam is the HQ of Krishna District.

sources.title: Sri Durga Malleswara Swamy Varla Devasthanam

districts.name: Palnadu
waterResources: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam (border project on Krishna River - Jawahar Canal irrigates Palnadu)
disasters: Extreme summer heatwaves (frequently records highest temperatures in AP)
economy: Cement Industry Hub (Macherla, Piduguralla - Lime City)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Dry deciduous forest patches along Nagarjuna Sagar backwaters and Nallamala fringe
dynasties: Satavahanas & Ikshvakus (Nagarjunakonda / Vijayapuri capital - 3rd c. CE)
Palnati Nayakururalu & Heroes (Battle of Karempudi - 12th Century)

temples.name: Kotappakonda Trikoteswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Perched on a hill with three prominent peaks representing Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva; famous for massive illuminated Prabhalu

temples.name: Nagarjunakonda Archaeological Complex
uniqueFacts: World's first island museum created in the middle of Nagarjuna Sagar reservoir containing transplanted Buddhist monuments

temples.name: Daida Rama Lingeswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Historic Shaivite shrine along the Krishna river course

temples.name: Gutti Konda Bilam
uniqueFacts: Cave complex associated with ancient rishis and spiritual retreats

festivalsAndCulture: Kotappakonda Mahashivaratri Jatara (famous for massive illuminated bamboo structures called Prabhalu up to 100 ft tall)
quickExtras: Nagarjunakonda: World's first island museum created to rescue Ikshvaku Buddhist ruins from reservoir submergence
dontConfuse: Kotappakonda Prabhalu are giant illuminated bamboo structures in Palnadu, distinct from Konaseema coconut Prabhas.

districts.name: Parvathipuram Manyam
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Wild Elephant migration corridor along Odisha border

temples.name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Principal urban shrine in the district HQ

temples.name: Thotapalli Sri Rama Temple
uniqueFacts: Situated near the Thotapalli Barrage site

temples.name: Paila Vasudeva Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Historic Vishnu shrine in the Agency belt

quickExtras: Thotapalli Barrage: Major irrigation venture named after Sardar Gauthu Latchanna providing water to North Coastal AP
dontConfuse: Bobbili town is in Vizianagaram District, while Parvathipuram is its own separate district HQ.

districts.name: Prakasam
waterResources: Gundlakamma Reservoir Project (Kandula Obul Reddy Project)
Cumbum Tank (historic dam built on Gundlakamma River by Princess Varadharajamma of Vijayanagara)
disasters: Drought in interior western mandals (Markapur/Giddalur belt)
livestockMinerals: Ongole Cattle Breed (*Bos indicus* - world-renowned draft breed)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Fringe zones of NSTR Tiger Reserve
historicalNotes: Addanki Inscription of Pandaranga (848 CE): Earliest documented verse (Taruvoja meter) in Telugu literature

temples.name: Singarakonda Prasannanjaneya Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Famous hill-top Hanuman shrine with Lakshmi Narasimha temple at base; major pilgrimage center

temples.name: Tripurantakam Tripurantakeswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Considered the Eastern Gateway to Srisailam (Purva Dvaram); Shiva temple on hill, Tripurasundari Devi shrine in pond temple below

temples.name: Bhairavakona Rock-cut Cave Temples
uniqueFacts: 8th-century monolith rock-cut cave temples showing Pallava influence; waterfall falls on Shiva Lingam

quickExtras: Motupalli Port: Ancient historic port visited by Venetian traveler Marco Polo; site of Motupalli Abhaya Sasanam issued by Kakatiya King Ganapatideva
dontConfuse: Markapuram is currently a revenue division within Prakasam District, NOT a separate official district.

districts.name: Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore (SPS Nellore)
waterResources: Somasila Dam (major reservoir across Penna River)
Kandaleru Dam (stores Krishna water via Telugu Ganga Canal)
disasters: High vulnerability to North-East monsoon cyclones
crops: Marine and Brackish Aquaculture (Shrimp Capital of Andhra Pradesh)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary (major breeding site for Grey Pelican)
Pulicat Lake Sanctuary (northern part in district)
dynasties: Telugu Chodas of Nellore (Raja Manumasiddhi - patron of poet Tikkana Somayaji who translated Mahabharatam)

temples.name: Ranganathaswamy Temple (Talpagiri Ranganathar)
uniqueFacts: Ancient temple on banks of Penna River featuring a huge Rajagopuram and reclining Vishnu on Adisesha; residence of poet Tikkana

temples.name: Jonnavada Kamakshi Sametha Mallikarjuna Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Major regional Shakti and Shaiva pilgrimage shrine on the Penna riverbank

temples.name: Penusila Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Swayambhu idol nestled in Veligonda hills

festivalsAndCulture: Rottela Panduga (Bread Festival) at Bara Shaheed Dargah
quickExtras: Sriharikota (SHAR - ISRO): Satish Dhawan Space Centre located on Sriharikota island (bordering Tirupati/Nellore coastal strip)
dontConfuse: Nelapattu and Sriharikota border zones are divided between SPS Nellore and Tirupati District.

districts.name: Sri Sathya Sai
historicalNotes: Penukonda served as secondary capital of Vijayanagara Empire after the fall of Hampi.

temples.name: Veerabhadra Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Premier Vijayanagara architectural masterpiece; features Hanging Pillar (Lamba Stambha), largest monolithic Nandi in India, world's largest monolithic 7-headed Nagalinga, and ceiling fresco paintings

temples.name: Penukonda Fort & Temples
uniqueFacts: Historical fort with 365 temples and Gagan Mahal palace

temples.name: Kadiri Laxmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Swayambhu Narasimha shrine where idol depicts emergence from pillar; major Grade-I temple; famous for massive wooden temple car

festivalsAndCulture: Kadiri Rathotsavam (massive wooden temple car festival)
quickExtras: Puttaparthi: Prashanthi Nilayam - spiritual ashram founded by Sri Sathya Sai Baba
dontConfuse: Lepakshi is located in Sri Sathya Sai District, NOT Ananthapuramu District.

districts.name: Srikakulam
terrain: Coastal plain backed by Eastern Ghats spurs
disasters: Extreme cyclone vulnerability (e.g., Cyclone Phailin, Titli landfall impacts)
River floods along Vamsadhara and Nagavali
economy: Ponduru Fine Khadi (hand-spun cotton from indigenous hill cotton)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Telineelapuram Bird Conservation Reserve (nesting site for Spot-billed Pelicans and Painted Storks)
dynasties: Eastern Gangas of Kalinganagara (Capital at Mukhalingam / Kalingapatnam - 8th–12th Century CE)

temples.name: Suryanarayana Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: One of the oldest surviving dedicated Sun Temples in India; constructed by Eastern Ganga King Devendra Varma (7th c. CE); solar alignment allows early sun rays to touch deity's feet on Ratha Saptami

temples.name: Sri Mukhalingeswara Temple Complex
uniqueFacts: Located on Vamsadhara riverbank; ancient capital of Eastern Gangas; trio of temples (Mukhalingeswara, Aniyanka Bheemeshwara, Someshwara) displaying Nagara/Kalinga architectural evolution

temples.name: Sri Kurmam Kurmanatha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Only prominent active temple in India dedicated to the Kurma (Tortoise) avatar of Lord Vishnu; features two dhwaja stambhams, rear-facing idol, and sanctuary for endangered tortoises

quickExtras: Salihundam: Major Buddhist site on hillock near Vamsadhara river featuring stupas, chaityas, and Viharas with Brahmi inscriptions
dontConfuse: Sri Kurmam is officially verified as the only major functioning temple dedicated to Kurma Avatar in Indian temple literature.

districts.name: Tirupati
disasters: High rainfall / flash flooding along Swarnamukhi basin during North-East monsoon
dynasties: Vijayanagara Emperors (Saluva, Tuluva - Krishnadevaraya visited 7 times)

temples.name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple
temples.administrativeStatus: Autonomous TTD under AP Endowments Act 30 of 1987
uniqueFacts: World's most visited Hindu temple; located on Venkatadri hill; gold-gilded Ananda Nilayam vimana; administered by TTD under statutory Act

temples.name: Srikalahasteeswara Temple
uniqueFacts: One of the Pancha Bhoota Stalams representing Vayu (Air); situated on Swarnamukhi riverbank; primary Rahu-Ketu Kshetram; sanctum lamp flame flickers continuously despite no draft

temples.name: Padmavathi Ammavari Temple
uniqueFacts: Primary shrine of Goddess Lakshmi/Padmavathi, consort of Venkateswara

temples.name: Govindaraja Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Major Vaishnava temple complex in Tirupati city consecrated by Saint Ramanujacharya

temples.name: Kapileswara Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Only Shiva temple in Tirupati city, situated at the foot of Tirumala hills near Kapila Theertham waterfall

temples.name: Parasurameswara Temple
uniqueFacts: Contains the oldest verified Shiva Lingam in the world (dated 3rd–2nd Century BCE by ASI); Lingam depicts realistic human phallus with hunter figure standing on Yaksha

festivalsAndCulture: Tirumala Annual Salakatla and Navaratri Brahmotsavams
quickExtras: Chandragiri Fort: Historic fort and Raja Mahal palace where Vijayanagara Emperor Sri Ranga Raya III granted land to the British for Fort St. George in 1639
dontConfuse: Gudimallam Lingam is ASI Protected as a 3rd-century BCE relic, distinct from medieval temple architectural styles.

districts.name: Visakhapatnam
terrain: Coastal urban hills (Dolphin's Nose, Kailasagiri, Rushikonda)
disasters: High cyclone risk (e.g., Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Hudhud in 2014)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Kambalakonda Wildlife Sanctuary (dry evergreen/deciduous forest sanctuary inside city limits - Indian Leopard, Barking Deer)

temples.name: Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Perched on Simhachalam hill; deity is continuously covered under a thick coat of Sandalwood paste (Chandanam), revealing actual form (Nija Rupa) only once a year on Chandanotsavam (Akshaya Tritiya)

temples.name: Kanakamahalakshmi Temple
uniqueFacts: Unique open-air shrine without a roof over the presiding deity

quickExtras: Dolphin's Nose: Prominent rocky promontory 174m high projecting into the sea, protecting natural harbor
dontConfuse: Simhachalam deity is Varaha Narasimha (combination of Boar and Lion avatars), NOT simple Narasimha.

districts.name: Vizianagaram
waterResources: Tatipudi Reservoir (across Gosthani River - supplies drinking water to Visakhapatnam)
terrain: Undulating plain dotted with isolated granite knolls and hillocks
disasters: Localized flash flooding in river valleys
crafts: Bobbili Veena (World-famous string instrument manufactured in Bobbili from single piece Jackwood - GI Tagged)
dynasties: Pusapati Royal Family (Vizianagaram Samsthanam - Gajapathi Raju rulers)
historicalNotes: Battle of Padmanabham (1794): Between Vijayarama Raju and British East India Company. Battle of Bobbili (1757): Historic siege between Bobbili and Vizianagaram aided by French General Bussy.

temples.name: Pydithalli Ammavari Temple
uniqueFacts: Principal patron Goddess of Vizianagaram city; famous for Sirimanotsavam festival
festivals: Sirimanotsavam (Priest perched on tip of 60-ft tall wooden pole - Sirimanu)

temples.name: Ramatheertham Sri Rama Temple
uniqueFacts: Ancient Vaishnava hill shrine located adjacent to 3rd c. BCE Buddhist monastic ruins on Bavikonda/Gurubhaktakonda hillocks

temples.name: Bobbili Venugopala Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Historic royal shrine of Bobbili fort kings

temples.name: Punya Giri Shiva Temple
uniqueFacts: Hilltop waterfall and Shaiva shrine surrounded by natural springs

quickExtras: Bobbili Veena: World-famous string instrument crafted from a single piece of Jackwood (GI Tagged)
dontConfuse: Sirimanotsavam is a unique cultural heritage event of Vizianagaram, explicitly recorded under AP Endowments/Cultural records.

districts.name: West Godavari
waterResources: Godavari Western Delta Canal System (Vijjeswaram lock/headworks)
disasters: High seasonal flooding in delta drains
crafts: Narsapur Crochet Lace (Hand-made Crochet Lace craft hub - GI Tagged)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Coastal mangrove patches along Narsapur coast
dynasties: Dutch East India Company at Narsapur (shipbuilding center)

temples.name: Somarama (Someshwara Swamy Temple)
uniqueFacts: One of the 5 Pancharama Kshetrams; Shiva Lingam changes color according to lunar phase (clear white on Full Moon, blackish on Amavasya)

temples.name: Ksheerarama (Ksheera Ramalingeswara Swamy Temple)
uniqueFacts: One of the 5 Pancharama Kshetrams; features a 9-storey 120-ft tall Rajagopuram built by Chalukyas and milky white Shiva Lingam

temples.name: Mavullamma Temple
uniqueFacts: Premier Grama Devatha shrine in the delta region; month-long Utsavams in Jan-Feb

quickExtras: Narsapur Lace Park: Hand-made Crochet Lace craft hub (GI Tagged)
dontConfuse: Two of the 5 Pancharamas—Somarama and Ksheerarama—are located within West Godavari District.

districts.name: YSR Kadapa
terrain: Surrounded by Palakonda and Nallamala hill arcs
Central red and black soil basin
disasters: River flooding in Penna basin during cyclonic rain spells
minerals: Barytes (Mangampeta - largest single barytes deposit in the world)
forestsWildlifeEnvironment: Sri Lankamalleswara Wildlife Sanctuary (only verified home of the critically endangered endemic bird Jerdon's Courser - Cursorius bitorquatus)
historicalNotes: Erragudipadu Inscription (575 CE): Issued by Erickal Mutturaju, earliest full stone inscription written in Telugu language.

temples.name: Vontimitta Sri Kodandarama Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Massive Vijayanagara temple constructed without Hanuman idol in sanctum (only Rama, Sita, Lakshmana carved on single silt stone); official venue for AP State Government Sri Rama Navami celebrations
festivals: Official AP State Sri Rama Navami Kalyanotsavam

temples.name: Devuni Kadapa (Sri Lakshmi Venkateswara Swamy Temple)
uniqueFacts: Known as the Dehleez (Threshold/Gateway) to Tirumala; traditional pilgrimage custom requires visiting Devuni Kadapa before proceeding to Tirumala

temples.name: Gandikota Ranganatha & Madhavaraya Temples
uniqueFacts: Historic temples situated inside Gandikota Fort directly above the Penna river gorge

temples.name: Pushpagiri Temple Complex
uniqueFacts: Known as the Kashi of the South; situated on banks of Penna River; site of the only Advaita Sankaracharya Matha in Andhra Pradesh

temples.name: Soumyanatha Swamy Temple
uniqueFacts: Ancient Chola-era Vishnu shrine featuring detailed stone pillars

festivalsAndCulture: Official State Sri Rama Navami Kalyanotsavam at Vontimitta
quickExtras: Gandikota Gorge: Known as the Grand Canyon of India, formed by Penna river cutting through Erramala hills
dontConfuse: Official AP Government Sri Rama Navami event takes place at Vontimitta (YSR Kadapa), NOT Bhadrachalam (which is in Telangana).
